messages.text:
The SSR error is from my dependency patch forcing Start server functions to use the fake resolver in the production server too.

Rather than keep fighting that package edge, I’m simplifying the backend boundary to explicit local API endpoints served by the built Start server adapter, and the React routes will call those endpoints.

That keeps the DB out of the browser and makes the app runtime straightforward.
